sources.title: Nigeria Immigration Service: 2026 Tourism (F5A) visa service level
sources.officialityEvidence: Nigeria Immigration Service's April 2026 service-level document defines F5A tourism eligibility for citizens of all countries, its online process, and delivery of a visa certificate by email.
sources.supportingExcerpt: F5A- TOURISM VISA ... Eligibility: Citizens of all countries ... Receive Visa certificate via email.

sources.title: Equatorial Guinea eVisa: live eligibility and electronic delivery translation asset
sources.officialityEvidence: The Government-authenticated exact domain currently serves its live Angular English translation asset. It says all nationalities may apply and that eVisas are emailed and downloadable as PDF.
sources.supportingExcerpt: All Nationalities can apply for an E- Visa ... All E-Visa are sent by email.

sources.title: Equatorial Guinea eVisa: live regular-passport translation asset
sources.officialityEvidence: The Government-authenticated exact domain's live English asset limits the eVisa application to the regular passport used for travel and excludes other travel documents.
sources.supportingExcerpt: The only travel document that can be used ... is your regular passport.

policies.title: Bosnia and Herzegovina civil passports: Nigeria tourism eVisa
policies.summary: Nigeria Immigration Service's current F5A tourism route accepts citizens of all countries and sends the tourism visa certificate by email before travel.
conditions: Apply online using a valid BiH civil passport with the F5A tourism supporting documents and payment; the visitor route is single entry for up to 30 days.
The emailed visa certificate is electronic issuance before travel, not online preapproval followed by border issuance.

Nigeria excepts ECOWAS States and countries with a visa-waiver agreement. Its current document does not identify a BiH civil-passport waiver; the all-country eVisa route is retained with medium confidence.

application.label: Nigeria Immigration Service tourism eVisa
steps: Apply online with the BiH civil passport and stated tourism documents.
Pay and receive the visa certificate by email before departure.
Present the certificate and supporting documents for carrier and final-admission checks.

policies.title: Bosnia and Herzegovina civil passports: Equatorial Guinea electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Equatorial Guinea's Government-authenticated live eVisa service accepts all nationalities using a regular passport and sends the eVisa by email as a PDF before travel.
conditions: Use the same valid BiH civil passport for application and travel; non-regular travel documents are not accepted.
Apply through the authenticated eVisa service and receive the eVisa by email in PDF form before travel. This is electronic issuance, not a visa on arrival.
The ordinary visitor route does not establish work, residence, special-document, carrier or final-admission entitlement.

application.label: Equatorial Guinea eVisa service
steps: Apply online using the BiH civil passport for travel.
Receive and retain the emailed PDF eVisa before departure.
Present the same passport and eVisa for final immigration processing and admission.
